◆Additional ability if attached to 〈Ayunda Risu〉

When the holomem this mascot is attached to collabs, you may reattach 1 cheer from your stage to this holomem.

Only 1 mascot can be attached to each of your holomem.
cards.illustrator: JinArt こばやかわやまと

cards.name: SSRB
cards.abilityText:
If you would archive a cheer by the ability of the holomem this fan is attached to, you may archive this fan instead of archiving 1 cheer.

You may only attach this fan to your 〈Shishiro Botan〉, and you may attach any number of this fan per holomem.
cards.illustrator: JinArt こばやかわやまと

cards.name: はあとん
cards.abilityText:
If the holomem this fan is attached to rolled a die by an ability, you may archive this fan:Ignore the previous results, and reroll the die.

You may only attach this fan to your 〈Akai Haato〉, and you may attach any number of this fan per holomem.
cards.illustrator: JinArt こばやかわやまと

cards.name: Ruffians
cards.abilityText:
During your opponent's turn, when the holomem this fan is attached to is downed, you may send 1 blue cheer from your archive to your 〈Fuwawa Abyssgard〉.

You may only attach this fan to your 〈Fuwawa Abyssgard〉 or 〈Mococo Abyssgard〉, and you may attach any number of this fan per holomem.
cards.illustrator: JinArt こばやかわやまと

cards.name: ころねすきー
cards.abilityText:
The holomem this fan is attached to requires -1 colorless for its baton pass.

You may only attach this fan to your 〈Inugami Korone〉, and you may attach any number of this fan per holomem.
cards.illustrator: JinArt こばやかわやまと

cards.name: Risuners
cards.abilityText:
[1/Turn]When a cheer is attached to the holomem this fan is attached to, during this turn, this holomem gets Arts+10.

You may only attach this fan to your 〈Ayunda Risu〉, and you may attach any number of this fan per holomem.
cards.illustrator: JinArt こばやかわやまと
